title: Persist owner accounts and revocable server sessions
requirements: Add the next Alembic revision for owner_accounts and owner_sessions exactly within the accepted database and API contracts.

Persist only a unique owner login, non-empty password hash, disabled marker and positive credentials version for the single administrative subject; no bootstrap account, plaintext password, role assignment or public registration is introduced.

Persist only a session-token digest, owner reference, credentials version, CSRF secret, created/last-seen/expiry timestamps and optional revocation marker. Raw session-cookie values must never be stored.

Add isolated PostgreSQL migration tests under tests/db006. They must create a uniquely named disposable database, apply Alembic head there, assert the required constraints and clean up in finally; they must never write to the configured source DATABASE_URL.
Do not add password verification, cookie handling, session endpoints, owner commands, notification delivery, production configuration or external authentication providers.
acceptance: A clean PostgreSQL database reaches the DB-006 Alembic head with owner account and revocable session storage, while all previous schema remains available.
The database rejects duplicate owner logins, invalid credentials versions, empty security material, invalid session expiry and a session without its owner.
Focused migration tests and whitespace checks pass, and the tests do not mutate the configured source database.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted owner-session persistence is the smallest prerequisite for the closed CRM API; the task excludes credential handling and runtime authentication.
